summary: Phase 136AM independently verifies Phase 136AL's implementation of NotificationAuthorityBinding (src/pcae/cltr/authority/bindings.py) -- Typed Model Implementation Group 7. Per governed instruction, this phase did not trust Phase 136AL's own field tables, fixtures, tests, helper functions, comments, decisions, or prior verification reports. The record contract was independently re-derived directly from the live executable schema records/notification_authority_binding.schema.json, the shared component schemas it composes, and the frozen contract text quoted in the schema's own description fields. A new, independently fixtured test module, tests/test_cltr_authority_136am_notification_authority_binding_independent.py, was written from scratch: every wire fixture and the independently re-derived DELIVERY_STATE_MEMBERS enum tuple was built directly from the live schema's field table and $defs, not copied from tests/test_cltr_authority_136al_notification_authority_binding.py. 109 tests were written (107 fast + 2 packaging/slow), all passing. No Blocking finding was independently reproduced. Every field, wrapper type, required/optional/nullable classification, all three conditional branches (uncertainty iff delivery_state=='payload_conflict'; marker_reference iff delivery_state!='not_dispatched'; receipt_reference iff delivery_state=='already_dispatched'), the 3-value delivery_state enum vocabulary, both reference family restrictions (marker_authority_binding, receipt_authority_binding), and error-behavior expectations independently derived matched bindings.py exactly. Two inherited findings were independently reproduced and confirmed pre-existing via an isolated git-stash baseline re-run of this phase's own starting commit (9b7b8c0f): stale wheel-content guards in test_cltr_authority_136ab_authority_core.py and test_cltr_authority_136ad_request_readiness.py, both inherited from Phase 136AL's addition of bindings.py, not a regression introduced by this phase. Regression: 1925 passed / 2 failed (both the two inherited findings above, zero new) / 1 skipped across all thirteen test_cltr_authority_136* modules; Fast Green 4391 passed, 0 failed, matching the 136AK-recorded baseline exactly; full quick-tier sweep 23271 passed / 25 failed / 9 skipped, every failing test ID cross-checked against known inherited categories, no unexplained new failure. Fresh wheel/sdist build plus isolated installed-wheel verification confirmed all twelve record-family models import and round-trip correctly with no later-group family present. Runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable throughout. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Verdict: NOTIFICATION AUTHORITY BINDING MODEL VERIFIED WITH NO NEW BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR MARKER AUTHORITY BINDING IMPLEMENTATION.
